name: TS6-Manager-Sidecar
description: TS6 Manager Sidecar - Go/Pion WebRTC media relay of the TS6 Manager stack. Streams live video from YouTube, Twitch or direct URLs into TeamSpeak channels. STACK: Used by TS6-Manager-Backend over HTTP on port 9800. Only needed for video streaming - music bots and everything else work without it. Has no web UI and stores no data.

ports.name: Sidecar API
ports.description: HTTP control API used by the backend. Keep it closed to the internet.

variables.name: Sidecar port
variables.description: Internal HTTP port. Must match the port in the backend's SIDECAR_URL.

variables.name: Debug logs
variables.description: Set to '1' for verbose debug logging of high-frequency stream details.
